title: Minimum internal floor area per Table 4.3a, plus 3 m2 per extra toilet and 5 m2 per extra bathroom
text: Dwellings have a minimum internal floor area in accordance with Table 4.3a.

evaluator.value: (36 if dwellings.min.bedrooms_of_smallest == 0 else 47 if dwellings.min.bedrooms_of_smallest == 1 else 67 if dwellings.min.bedrooms_of_smallest == 2 else 90) + 5 * max(0, dwellings.min.bathrooms_of_smallest - 1) + 3 * dwellings.min.separate_toilets_of_smallest
evaluator.label: Table 4.3a: studio 36, 1 bed 47, 2 bed 67, 3 bed 90 m2 (one bathroom); +5 m2 per additional bathroom; +3 m2 per second or separate toilet

notes: from: ch4p1 C2.1.6. diverges: studio 36 m2 (ch4p1 37 m2). Table 4.3a (table-4.3a, reference) is carried in the formula so the footnote additions can be added. verify: the footnote marker is printed on the 2 bed and 3 bed rows only, so whether +3/+5 m2 applies to a studio or 1 bed with a second toilet or bathroom is unclear (applied to all here, as ch4p1); 4+ bedrooms are not printed and are read as the 3 bed row.

verified.note: Table 4.3a sizes 36/47/67/90 m2 confirmed. Footnote 1 marker is printed on "2 bed x 1 bath" and "3 bed x 1 bath" only (not studio or 1 bed), while the footnote wording is general; the formula applies +3/+5 m2 to all types. 4+ bedrooms not printed (read as 3 bed).
